what_happened: Dispatch states specs/ and .claude/ are gitignored and absent from a fresh worktree; in this repository (and a surveyed Lean consumer) specs/ is TRACKED, so a batch worktree carries a HEAD-stale specs/ copy and the symlink candidate cannot apply. Design must cover both postures.

guard-destructive-git.sh and validate-task-creation-audit.sh blocked scratch-fixture commands (git add ., git restore, a fixture JSON write) because the hook evaluates the session tree's dirtiness and command text, not the command's target repository; worked around by rewriting the fixture commands. Doubles as evidence for the two-root audit.
